decisions: Separate FinishAfter eligibility, EscrowFinish execution, subsequent transfer, re-escrow and market disposition; never equate 1B scheduled unlock with 1B tradable float or sell pressure.
Use prior 12-month 70% re-escrow only as a scenario, not a guaranteed November outcome.
Keep RLUSD chain-specific and pin XRPL issuer obligations to a validated ledger, Ethereum totalSupply to a block, and additional networks to approved contract/bridge mappings.
Treat XRP Insights, stables.cool and XRPL.to as correlated observations, not three independent confirmations.
Quarantine XR-Lineage 910.3M until its 2,000-trustline scope and raw query are resolved.
Separate Ripple's Oct29 live issuer display from Deloitte's Sep21/30 independent attestation.
Treat Coinbase listing as distribution/network access; Global Exchange RLUSD collateral is deferred until separately launched and verified.
Do not infer actual capital or XRP demand from RLUSD chain supply, transfer counts, exchange custody or RWA registry notional.
Admit no directional XRP feature or forecast from this run.
Do not merge/rebase stale PRs or modify main; preserve writer/privacy findings for approved remediation.
required_verification: After Nov1 00:00Z, capture EscrowFinish hashes, timestamps, destination balances and subsequent EscrowCreate transactions at pinned ledgers.
Trace subsequent Ripple transfers and exchange/OTC destinations without equating internal treasury moves with sales.
Recompute RLUSD issuer obligations on XRPL and totalSupply on Ethereum at aligned cutoffs; reconcile Base, Optimism, Ink, Unichain and XRPL EVM flows.
Obtain XR-Lineage raw response and reconcile 910.3M with canonical issuer obligations.
Verify any Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral launch and live parameters.
Extend fixed-horizon ledger with mandatory source registry, concurrent-writer safety and leakage-safe walk-forward evaluation before forecasting.
Resolve main workflow quarantine and subscriber privacy only through approved changes.
rationale: Escrow and RLUSD supply are event/custody context, not validated directional predictors; no model has passed walk-forward skill and calibration gates.
